mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMPANION_WISHLIST (WISHLIST_NO, COMPANION_NO, MEMBER_NO) VALUES (SEQ_COMPANION_WISHLIST_NO.NEXTVAL, #{companionNo}, #{memberNo})
mapper.select: SELECT CB.COMPANION_NO AS "companionNo", CB.TITLE AS "title", CB.TRAVEL_DATE AS "travelDate", CB.MAX_MEMBERS AS "maxMembers", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMPANION_JOIN J WHERE J.COMPANION_NO = CB.COMPANION_NO AND J.STATUS IN ('W', 'A')) AS "currentMembers", CB.IMAGE_URL AS "imageUrl", W.CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" FROM COMPANION_WISHLIST W JOIN COMPANION_BOARD CB ON W.COMPANION_NO = CB.COMPANION_NO WHERE W.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY W.CREATED_AT DESC
